author: The Current
description:
Artist Patti Smith considers the intersection of grief and gratitude
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

In an interview with Jill Riley on The Current’s Morning Show, Patti Smith shared her thoughts about the link between grief and gratitude. "We're always going to feel a certain amount of sorrow or loss," Smith says, "But I found the way to help me navigate that was gratitude."

Watch the full video to hear more on this from Patti Smith.
